name: genpark-agentic-commerce-rfq-multi-vendor-bidding-arbiter-skill
description: Autonomous B2B RFQ (Request for Quote) Multi-Vendor Bidding Arbiter. Scores wholesale quotations across unit volume pricing, minimum order quantities (MOQ), landed tariffs, net payment terms (Net 30/60), and historical supplier lead-time reliability.

tools.name: arbitrate_vendor_bids
tools.description: Arbitrate multi-vendor RFQ bids and select the optimal supplier based on total landed cost and risk.

vendor_bids.description: Bids with vendor_name, unit_price_usd, moq, shipping_cost_usd, payment_terms_days, quality_rating_pct.
